violations.title: Equipment Cooking Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment were observed soiled with an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: 4DWR 1DR under counter cooler for pizza making was dirty with melted butter in and on the outside of the cooler. It was also dirty with other food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris to maintain a sanitary work environment and prevent pest attraction. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL EQUIPMENT NEEDS TO BE KEPT CLEAN TO SIGHT AND TOUCH. PIC TOLD EHS THEY WILL GET IT TAKEN CARE FOR BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor around and underneath the dish washer is in need of a deep cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE FLOORS NEED TO BE CLEANED REGULARLY AND ON A CLEANING SCHEDULE. PIC SAID THEY WILL TAKE CARE OF IT BY NEXT INSPECTION.
